_comment: Sub-agents generated into each plugin by sync_manifests.py. The body is the concatenation of `sources` (paths relative to the plugin); edit those files, never the generated agents. `cut` drops each source from that heading on.

agents.name: scan-code-discovery
agents.description: Read-only discovery pass for the scan-code skill's llm-threat-audit lane: the inventory and threat model, one component x category cell, or a sweep. Proposes candidates that name an attacker-controlled source, a sink and every hop between them with file:line anchors, records the files it opened, and never judges its own candidates. Use only when dispatched by the scan-code skill.

agents.name: scan-code-verifier
agents.description: Blind, read-only verification of one scan-code candidate through one lens (reachability, impact, defenses or red-team). Defaults to FALSE_POSITIVE, cites file:line for every step, and returns a JSON verdict that gate_findings.py tallies; never sees the reporting tools, vote counts or other lenses. Use only when dispatched by the scan-code skill.
